scenario: `nocooldown` is an independently gateable sub-form of `call` per LFCA.6.1 — a tier can allow `call` but disable the `nocooldown` opt-out. Under `restricted_v1` (which disables all async forms), `call ... nocooldown` is also rejected with DS_VALIDATE_FORM_DISABLED.
rules_ds:
use restricted_v1

service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id nocooldown
